The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's answer at step 28. It reported the upper estimate as "approximately 59 million," a figure that doesn't appear in the page content it had retrieved. The OCR'd text showed only partial tables (Galapagos, Humboldt, Fiordland, Yellow-eyed, African, and Snares penguins) and no global total. The orchestrator then accepted the figure without verification at step 29 and passed it to the calculation. The CSV count of 291 out of 344 is consistent with the expected answer, so the wrong denominator is what produced the incorrect 0.00049 instead of 0.00033.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 28
